fusions.name: By Order
fusions.desc: Sends out a bolt that deals 28 damage. For 12 seconds after it hits, allies strike 20% harder.

fusions.name: Rap Over Knuckles
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Official Announcement
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Standing Order
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 6%.
